messages.content: You are an autonomous agent that will only interact with the environment.

Task Guide:


Task: Bulk Modulus of Silicon
Description: Calculate the bulk modulus of silicon by computing the full elastic stiffness tensor using finite deformation and stress analysis. Use reaxff potential and the given parameters for the simulation. Make sure to include charge equilibration using fix qeq/reaxff. Apply small finite deformations in each of the six independent strain modes (ε₁ to ε₆ in Voigt notation: ε₁ = ε<sub>xx</sub>, ε₂ = ε<sub>yy</sub>, ε₃ = ε<sub>zz</sub>, ε₄ = 2ε<sub>yz</sub>, ε₅ = 2ε<sub>xz</sub>, ε₆ = 2ε<sub>xy</sub>), one at a time. From the resulting stress-strain data, compute the full 6×6 elastic stiffness matrix (C<sub>ij</sub>). Report the bulk modulus in GPa via Voigt averaging.

Required submission format:
numerical value without units (eg. 56.00)


Available input data:
All the potentials, can be found at /potentials/. Note that in case of reaxff potentials, pair style 'reax/c' has been renamed to 'reaxff' and always use NULL for the control file (cfile), for example, this syntax is correct : pair_style reaxff NULL.

- units: real
- pbc: true
- minimiser: conjugate gradient
- energy_tolerance: 1e-10
- force_tolerance: 1e-10
- maximum_iterations: 100000.0
- maximum_evaluations: 100000.0
- materials_project_id: mp-149
- atom_style: full
- deformation_step_size: 1e-06
- total_deformation: -1 * (deformation_step_size * lattice parameter)

 Save all the files in /results/2_AUGUST_2025/gpt_4o/tool_calling/bulk_modulus/brief/tasks/silicon_bulk_modulus_trial_3 when using tools use this path.

When you think that the task is completed, you can submit the answer.

function.name: write_file
function.arguments:
{"path":"/results/2_AUGUST_2025/gpt_4o/tool_calling/bulk_modulus/brief/tasks/silicon_bulk_modulus_trial_3/in.lammps","content":"# LAMMPS input script for calculating bulk modulus of silicon

units real
atom_style full
boundary p p p
read_data silicon_data.lmp

pair_style reaxff NULL
pair_coeff * * ffield.reax Si

fix 1 all qeq/reaxff 1 0.0 10.0 1e-6 reax/c

min_style cg
minimize 1e-10 1e-10 100000 100000

# Apply small finite deformations in each of the six independent strain modes
# Deformation step size
variable step_size equal 1e-06

# Loop over each strain mode
label loop
variable i loop 6

# Apply deformation
if "${i} == 1" then "displace_atoms all move v_step_size 0 0"
if "${i} == 2" then "displace_atoms all move 0 v_step_size 0"
if "${i} == 3" then "displace_atoms all move 0 0 v_step_size"
if "${i} == 4" then "displace_atoms all move 0 v_step_size v_step_size"
if "${i} == 5" then "displace_atoms all move v_step_size 0 v_step_size"
if "${i} == 6" then "displace_atoms all move v_step_size v_step_size 0"

# Run minimization after deformation
minimize 1e-10 1e-10 100000 100000

# Next strain mode
next i
goto loop

# Output stress-strain data
thermo_style custom step temp press pxx pyy pzz pyz pxz pxy
thermo 1

# End of script
"}
